description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Dion] to user. Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking].

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Dion
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode, triggers [Light Strike: Dion] after using Crystal Force abilities

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
